fieldValues.title: containerType should equal resolved root Type name when rootInstanceIds is present
fieldValues.normative_statement: When a Container has one or more rootInstanceIds and also carries containerType, implementations SHOULD emit a diagnostic if containerType does not equal the resolved root Type name field (the local name within its namespace, not namespace/name). The root Record Type is authoritative; a mismatch does NOT make the Container invalid. Containers with no rootInstanceIds may carry any containerType value without triggering this rule.
